title: lespedeza thunbergii subsp. formosa
intro: Lespedeza thunbergii subsp. formosa, commonly known as Korean Lespedeza, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Korean Lespedeza include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support the immune system, with its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds are thought to contribute to the plant's therapeutic effects, although further research is needed to fully understand its potential benefits and mechanisms of action.
